name: Events
storyline:
You will be tasked with identifying and reporting anomalies such as misplaced, missing, or altered objects (e.g., furniture) as well as any other unusual or suspicious activities such as intruders that occur during your monitoring duties.

Do you possess the necessary skills to ensure Management's contentment throughout your shift? Only time will tell...
summary: Events is an anomaly-style horror game designed to challenge your cognitive abilities and test your memory. You must closely observe the monitored area, recall its original state, and report anything unusual. This includes anything that is misplaced, missing, or altered objects (e.g., furniture).
